title: WW3 GPU Lab: agentic coding and agentic research on a bit-for-bit GPU port of WAVEWATCH III
description:
A book in progress on agentic coding and agentic research, compiled from the repository that is its evidence, written around one problem: moving the expensive kernels of the WAVEWATCH III (WW3) third-generation spectral wind-wave model to GPUs without changing the answer.

  • Seventeen lessons, built into a PDF on every merge, from the wave spectrum to running the Fortran model on real cases with a pinned Nix toolchain and annotated switch files.
  • Benchmarks on CPU (OpenMP, MPI) and GPU (OpenACC, CUDA Fortran), each number with the command that reproduces it.
  • A C++/Kokkos port of W3SNL1, the Discrete Interaction Approximation (DIA) of nonlinear four-wave interactions, written with coding agents and shown bit-identical to the Fortran on the Serial, OpenMP and CUDA backends by a field-by-field parity harness.
  • The method itself: the rules coding agents follow here, design docs with a definition of done (WFIPs), decision records (ADRs), a research log, and plans whose every claim carries its evidence.

Includes runnable examples, exercises with solutions, and an undergraduate project proposal (Escola Politécnica, UFRJ, co-advised at LabECO, UFSC).
